row.notes: Global name -> id interning (name kept: it is L2 upstream under this name). Generic, not only model nodes (verify-e/verify-d: callers also pass CutSceneScript, Grading Preset, OVERLAY): djb2 of the C string (seed 0x1505, *33+c), lookup FUN_143a3df70(hash, name) under the shared read lock 0x14618ce18; on miss takes the write lock, looks up again and inserts the string into the name arena (g 0x14618ce20, 0x20000-byte blocks from allocator 0x14618ce10), returning the new id. Ids index the name table [0x14618ce08]+8 (16-byte entries), the same id space Game_Scene_FindByName and scene +0xe8 use. ~1000 callers. (used by vmknolle parts-detach)
